description.value: Mike's Place is a beloved Gibsons institution that has been hand-crafting house-made gelato from natural, fresh ingredients since 2003, with dozens of flavors including a full dairy-free lineup. Beyond gelato, it operates as a full café serving espresso drinks, paninis, soups, sandwiches, wraps, and fresh-baked sourdough bread, all enjoyed on a scenic outdoor deck overlooking the seaside town. It also serves as a Purolator quick-stop depot, making it a genuine community hub for locals and visitors alike.

address.value: 268 Gower Point Road, Gibsons, BC V0N1V0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and corroborates the OSM address (268 Gower Point Road, Gibsons, BC) and URL. The site explicitly states free Wi-Fi for customers and lists dairy-free gelato, vegetarian/vegan-friendly food options (Veggie panini, Pesto Veggie wrap, Caprese), and a full counter-service food menu that inherently supports takeout. No bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or charging amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; phone 604-886-5320 sourced from website only.

Business operates under two names: OSM uses 'Mike's Place' while website domain and branding also uses 'Mike's Gelato' — both names appear on the website itself, so this is intentional dual branding, not a mismatch.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible café and gelato shop with a current website, confirmed address, and broad food and drink offerings appealing to touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Dairy-free gelato flavors listed (Strawberry, Mango, Lemon, etc.); vegetarian panini (Veggie, Caprese) and wrap (Pesto Veggie) options on menu; gluten-free gelato cake base available for additional cost
